text.tspan: Attachment invalidates existing OCE sessions, do not retry it.
On startup failure, attempt owned cleanup.
If cleanup is incomplete, retain state for occ dev down.

svg.text: Check discovery and client through HTTPS publication
Sign in as administrator, read account ID
Reauthenticate for recovery, attach Alice's subject
Return authorization URL with state, PKCE and nonce
Follow URL and authenticate as Alice
Redirect to OCE with authorization code
Send code and state to callback
